title: Hotspot
description: A numbered marker placed over a figure that the learner selects to reveal what it points at (a click event; usually reveal-step). It pulses while it is the next thing to select, then stays as a plain marker.
instructions: Place it in a stacked figure (layout split with figure: stack), in the same step as the figure part it points at, and give it a click event, usually { "type": "reveal-step", "step": <next step> }. x and y are the marker's centre in % of the figure width and height (from the figure's generator). The label names what selecting it shows and contains the marker number.

marker.description: Number shown on the marker; the matching stat card or text uses the same number.

label.description: Accessible name of the button: what selecting it shows, with the marker number (Orbit 1: Space Station).

x.description: Horizontal centre of the marker, in % of the figure width.

y.description: Vertical centre of the marker, in % of the figure height.

accent.description: Colour of the pulse around the marker.
